english: W-wait! Time! Tiiime-out!\nRiko's still in her underwear!
Huh?!
Kufu. Peeking on Riko, the peeping expert-\nnot bad.
You're a top-class pervert!\nKufufu!
Getting seen in such an indecent state\nreally gave me a little jolt, honestly!
(Why is she suddenly being polite…)
It was beyond my control…!\nI mean, nobody would expect someone\nstripping in a place like this…
Nooo, you don't get it!\nThe thrill is the whole point!
Besides, I was in a hurry-\nI have to fix my parachute fast,\nor I'll be in trouble when I need it!
That's the one you usually wear\nas your uniform, right?
Yup yup. Wow, you really were looking.\nNaauughty~
(Whatever I say, I just dig myself deeper…)
Wh-what's wrong, all of a sudden?!
You've seen me…\nA man saw me in an indecent state…
Now I can never get married…\nWill you take responsibility for me?
A-are you serious?!
Too bad, I lied!
…That was crocodile tears, right?
You're no fun!\nBoo, boo!
…So it was all a lie after all.\nDon't scare me like that.
Riko's a thief, after all~.\nLying is kind of part of the job~.
Huh? Did you maybe believe it\nfor a second there?
I did not!
Kufufu! That was hilarious!\nSuch a genuine reaction!
Oh, I'm doing the rest over there,\nso no peeking-bad!
If you peek, I'll get all huffy and pounce on you.\nAnd I'll tell the scary big sisters on you?
(Ugh, what a nuisance…\nIs that what they call a troublemaker?)
Hm? This outfit? A white-lolita-style arrangement\nof the Butei High girls' uniform!\nMy pride and joy!
Not that-the one you're sewing by hand,\nand the clothes scattered around here.
This? This is sweet lolita,\nand that one's a princess-lolita offshoot!
Which one's your type?
I can't tell the difference…
Ehh?! You can't tell?!\nYou should study up!
If you looked it up on Wikipe or something,\nthey'd list the types, y'know?
(What's 'Wikipe'?)
I mean, this time you're sewing\nwhile still in uniform.
Well, there's a top-class pervert around!
(Dug myself deeper again…)
What's that in the back?\nIt doesn't look like sweet lolita or anything.
That stuff over there is my work outfit-\nhobby and business combined!
Like flight-attendant uniforms, police uniforms!\nThere's even a bunny-girl outfit!
What do you use so many of them for?
I said hobby AND business!
It's not just a hobby?
Tch-tch-tch! You don't get it!\nRiko's a master-of-disguise thief, y'know?
They're disguise tools for sneaking into\nall sorts of places, obviously!
For disguises?
Ding-ding! Correct!
Uniforms are handy!\nSomewhere with lax security,\njust wearing a uniform gets you right in!
I see. So, how many outfits do you\nactually own?
Hmm, never counted.\nSchool uniforms, casual clothes, and work clothes\nall together… yeah, no idea.
I've got that many!\nHmm, did one of them catch your eye~?
Pure curiosity! Where and how do you even\nstore that many clothes?
Wanna know?
Uh, well, sure.
I won't tell anyone who isn't\ninto lolita!
Kufufufu! A good woman always\nhas her secrets!
Ehh…
Huh? Come back to peep again?
No! I'm just listening to everyone\nto gather information!
Ohh, information gathering?\nLeave that to Riko!
Looks can deceive-I'm a Butei rank A\nin Butei High's detective department!
(I don't know the scale, so all I can think\nis 'sounds impressive'…)
Hm? You've got a 'I don't get it' face on?
Allow me to explain! Rank indicates\na Butei's ability!
From the bottom: E, D, C, B, A,\nand above those, the special S rank!
So you're pretty high up, then.
Huh? Isn't Aria-san higher…?
I-I see, rank A is really impressive!
That's right! I'll get my hands on\neven the tiniest bit of info!
…Actually, I came because I wanted to know\nmore about you, Riko-san.
About me? Could it be\nyou're dying of curiosity~?
Can't be helped, nyaa!\nUm, double-schooling at I-U and Butei High,\nButei rank A!
Armed with two tactical knives and\ntwo pistols loaded with 16 rounds!
Also, my hobby is dating sims\nand my skills are disguise and thievery!
(Dating sims?)
And my measurements are…
Your measurements?
Curious after all?\nKufufu! …You perv!
(Dammit… I just went with the flow…)
My measurements aren't something\nI'll just give away, y'know?
Let's see… if you beat me at a game,\nI might tell you?
And what's more!\nRight now it comes with a deluxe bonus,\nfirst-press limited edition!
No, not really…
If you don't play, I'll blab to Aria\nand the others about the peeping!
…I'll play.
Yeees! One challenger, coming right up!\nKufufu! I gotta hurry home and plan it out!
Look forward to it!
(Ugh, teased AND dragged into something weird…)
(What is she going to make me do…)
Kufufufu! Welcome, brave hero!
What's with that character…?
Ehh? You don't even know this?\nIt's the demon king's template line\nfrom RPGs and stuff.
And just when you think you've beaten him,\nhe changes form and you have to fight him\nagain, y'know?
Oh, hold on a sec.\nI'm still putting it together.
Is that whitish lump the game equipment?
Riko's homemade plastic explosives!
E-explo…?! Why do you even\nhave something like that…?
'Cause Riko's a bomb user.\nI've also got liquid, solid, and gas explosives,\na full lineup!
I asked when it was clothes, but how do you\ncarry around that much stuff…?
Trade secret! If you clear the game,\nI might tell you as a bonus?
…So what kind of game are you planning\nto play with bombs?
Oh, nice, nice! That's the spirit!
It's a bomb-defusal game using this screwdriver!\nTouch the wrong spot and-BOOM!
I'll die!
Ehh! I'll adjust the gunpowder so it\nwon't kill you, promise!\nEven if it blows up, it'll just change your hairstyle.
At Butei High, lead flying around\nis totally normal, y'know?
Besides, it's boring without a little thrill!
The moment you said 'bomb,'\nit stopped being 'a little'…
C'mon! A man needs guts, y'know?
…Did you really adjust it?
What's with that reaction…?!
Kufufufufu! Well seen through, brave hero!
(Knew it…)
A-a different one, please.\n…Actually, not playing at all would be best.
Bzzzt! No dropping out!
Then how about a miraculous escape game!
Escape game?
I lock you in a box,\nand if you escape within the time limit, you clear it!
One that doesn't use bombs, please…
I went to all the trouble of preparing them!\nWell, whatever. I use them for work too.
Okay, planning the game is homework I'll\ntake home-I'll think about it more!\nKufufu!
See ya!
(No matter how you look at it, that's overkill,\nbut at Butei High, using gunpowder and having\nbullets flying around is normal…)
(I hope the next game is a normal one…)
Let's play a thief game!
Another game with a dangerous-sounding name…\nLike last time, but why…?
'Cause Riko's a thief!\nAnd since you whined about bombs,\nI thought this up for you?
Oh, and don't worry, it's not a bank\nor some rich person's mansion!
No skills needed! Just have guts!\nPerfect for beginners!
That still only gives me a bad feeling…
Steal Aria's secret stash of peach buns!
The treasure is inside the bag\nshe always carries!
Isn't that impossible…?
Not at all!\nLike I said, guts are all you need!
While she's changing,\nor in the bath,\nor you could strike while she sleeps!
All I can picture is getting caught\nand beaten half to death…\nCan't we do a different one?
I just really want to eat one…
A dim, freezing interrogation room,\nnot a single ally in sight.\nI want the peach bun I ate back then…
That was when you went to testify\nto get Aria-san's mother a reduced sentence.
I can't forget the warmth and sweetness\nof the peach bun they served me\ninstead of katsudon…
Something like that happened…
Nope! Not at all!
Crocodile tears again…
You're such an easy mark!
…Crocodile tears again.
Caught me?
I knew it…
Whoa! You were bluffing?\nYou're learning!
Someone told me there's a saying:\n'Lying is the first step to thievery'…
Exactly! So it can't be helped!\nThere's also a saying about knowing\nwhen to give up.
And so, the thief game begins!
I have no choice, do I…
With your fast legs, you'll be fine!\nWith your fast legs!
I said it twice because it's important!
Oh, right! Bonus rule!\nIf peach buns are a no-go,\nstealing her heart is fine too!
He stole something outrageous.\n…Your heart!
That's even more impossible…
Okay, do your best!
(So I got roped into it after all…\nCan I do it without getting caught…)
(Oh, right. I don't actually have to steal anything-\nI can just buy some peach buns somewhere!)
(Finding them will be tough, but still better\nthan stealing Aria-san's peach buns…)
Riko-san, I bought… er, stole these\npeach buns from Aria-san.
Wh-?! Aria-san?! Why are you here!\nThat was a lie! I didn't steal them,\nI just bought them…
Thought I was Aria?\nToo bad! It was me, Riko-chan!
No cheating-bad!\nTrying to fool Riko the thief?\nYou're a hundred years too early!
So? Surprised?\nYou were surprised, right?
I thought my heart was going to stop.
You'd put those reaction-comedy guys to shame!\nImpressive!
You were silent, so I got suspicious.
Ehh? Really?\nEven though you were panicking so much?
…I was putting on a brave face.
Yep! Honesty is the best policy, y'know?
(You're one to talk…)
And now, the moment you've been waiting for-\nthe results!
(I can tell without you saying it…)
…Too baaad! No clear!\nSo the peach buns are confiscated!
Plus, a penalty!\nThe real Aria-san appears!
Ehh?! …She's not here, though.
I said Aria would appear. That was a lie.
That's cruel…
Sadly, you failed the challenge, so\nno measurements and no deluxe bonus!
And since you cheated, maybe I'll blab\nto Aria about last time too!
Wh-! Please don't!
Really? Well, can't be helped!\nOne more chance!
By the way, if you cheat again,\nI'll really blab!
Now then, I gotta plan the next game!\n…If you run, I'll get all huffy and pounce on you!
(It continues…)
Mmmmmm…\nI can't think of a game idea…
Something not-quite-fatal but rough, with thrills,\nand fun for me to watch…
(She's saying some pretty dangerous stuff…)
Ugh, I'm in a slump…\nNothing good's coming to mind…
Maybe I'll just go with a normal game…\nBut I didn't bring any board games or a pool table…
(After seeing all those clothes,\nI wouldn't be surprised if she carried those too…)
Hey, can you play poker?
Not at all.
Tch! I can't go up against an amateur!
(Serious in the weirdest places…)
As a special treat, I'll face you\nin my area of expertise.
…Like healing?
Fun idea, but I can't do that!\nScrapped! Retake!
Ehh… Then, like, housework?\nI've been helping out with stuff lately.
Housework, huh…
Lately, housework, I guess.\nI've been helping out now and then.
…Plain. Suits you, though.
Leave me alone…
Housework, housework… How about\na sewing showdown?!
Sure, but…
Okay, rules: whoever sews this frill\nonto a Butei High uniform first wins!
You're planning to increase your uniform\ncollection even more.\n…Wait, are you just making me do your chores?
It's a bonus, a bonus!\nDon't sweat the details!
Here, the uniform and the frill.
Oh, and that uniform's brand new, so sniffing it\nis pointless! …Or would a freshly-worn one\nget you more fired up?
N-no thanks, I'll pass…
Kufufu! Your face is all red?\n…And go!
No fair!
No way… I lost…?
(That was fast, thanks to J's help.\nDid you want to know my measurements that badly…)
F-fine! A loss is a loss, I'll keep my promise.
But I haven't prepared anything,\nso some other time!
(So she never thought she'd lose.\nI don't know what the bonus is, but at least\nmy misdeeds won't get blabbed…)
Oh, I forgot to ask her measurements.
This is… a school?\nThere's a sign: 'Café SHC'…
Welcome home, Master~!
Riko-san?! Th-that outfit…!
Ta-daa! It's the deluxe-bonus\ncosplay Rikorin!
Plus! A special menu just for you, Master!\nFirst-flush Darjeeling and Riko's favorite parfait!
Kufufu! From here on, it's the sweet, sweeet\nevent scene on the Riko route!
Here, Master! Say ahh…
Huh? Wh-what?!
Hm? Not to your liking?\nYou'd rather mouth-to-mouth than 'say ahh'…?
Or maybe you don't like the outfit?\nThen maybe I'll just… cast off!
W-wait, Riko-san?!
Kufu… could it be you want to do\nsomething else?
It's fine, Master.\nI'll do anything you say!\nAaaanything, okay?
R-Riko-san…!
Yeees! Did you call, Master?
H-huh? The usual uniform…?
You're drooling, y'know? Kufufu, so you\nwere having a pervy dream!
I went to all the trouble of bringing the deluxe bonus,\nand you were sleeping there all lovestruck!\nI'm gonna get all huffy and pounce on you?
No, it's just… S-so, what is\nthis deluxe bonus?
Ta-daa! It's this!
Huh? That black dress?\nWhat do you call this kind of thing again…
I explained it the other day!\nThis is goth loli!
I feel like I heard that, and like I didn't…\nSo why is this the deluxe bonus?
Why, obviously! Because it was\na pain to prepare!
Come on, try it on right away! Kufu!
…No thanks.
Ehh! You're slender, so I thought\nit'd suit you!
A goth-loli chuuni trap with bandages\nwrapped around his right arm-\nI thought the stacked settings were hilarious.
Kufufu! What eroge is that from?\n…What, too many attributes?
(I have no idea what she's saying…)
